newsitem.title: SPAIN: CEPSA Algeria RFK output rose to 20,000 b.
newsitem.headline: CEPSA Algeria RFK output rose to 20,000 b.

text.p: Spanish oil firm Cia Espanola de Petroleos SA (CEPSA) said on Wednesday that output from its Rhourde El Khrouf (RKF) Algeria field had reached 20,000 barrels per day (bpd).
In a statement, Cepsa said that having received permission to operate all of its wells in the RKF field, output had been boosted to 20,000 bpd on July 20 from 8,000 bpd last week.
Cepsa said the crude was extremely light and of "excellent" quality. The field has seven producer wells and three gas reinjection wells.
"The RKF field is now at a sustained production level, with an estimated plateau of around 20,000 bpd," Cepsa said.
Cepsa shares RKF's operating rights with Algeria's Sonatrach.
Accumulated output from June 1996 to date was more than 2.8 million barrels, Cepsa said. Reserves in the RKF field total around 150 million barrels, the company has said.
